Carousel items

Drag the handle to reorder announcements. Each slide has its own styling, close button, CTA and text animations. Closing dismisses only that item, with optional per-item confirmation. The progress indicator disappears when one announcement remains. Subtitle line breaks create rotating messages.

Each new line is a different message. Enter / Return creates another subtitle that rotates in the same snackbar slide (not a visual line break).

The active indicator grows from left to right, then the next carousel item appears. The floating close button dismisses only the current item. Remaining announcements continue cycling.
